correctness.rationale: For the repaired statement, a face fails exactly when it contains a connected five-vertex subset. Generating those subsets by adjacency growth from singletons and removing all supersets gives 21,973 faces. A fresh exact computation with bit order 15,..,8,0,..,7 produced 10,976 disjoint toggle pairs and checked acyclicity by sorting every face across all 135,760 oriented incidences. The only augmented critical cells are 21 in dimension seven. Removing the empty face releases its matched vertex, preserving acyclicity; the resulting ordinary Morse CW model has one vertex and 21 seven-cells with constant attaching maps. The repaired artifact reproduces certificate.json exactly. For the frozen original proof, the independent replay rebuilt every stage and reproduced its signed matrices, the three lifted zero boundaries and their supports, and both determinant-+1 minors. In addition an alternate matching on the relative chain complex of (Ind_3,Ind_2) has four critical cells in each of degrees six and seven, with Smith factors all 1; its relative homology is zero. This independently confirms the claimed natural inclusion on homology. The original absolute Morse models are simply connected; Hurewicz and the homological Whitehead theorem justify the asserted homotopy types and map, not merely their Betti ranks.
residual_risks: The exact computation is exhaustive only for GP(8,3) and the stated cutoffs. The repaired result and proof do not assert an equivariant type or a statement for an arbitrary graph.

value.rationale: Cutoff four is the immediate, structurally motivated test after two adjacent, homotopy-equivalent stages of a canonical cubic graph. The result shows that the old degree-six classes vanish there and that new integral degree-seven topology appears, with its full sphere rank and homotopy type. It is useful for the upper endpoint of the known plateau and as an exact benchmark distinguishing the dependence on the component cutoff; neither a recomputation of cutoff two nor an arbitrary isolated stage.
residual_risks: This is a motivated finite invariant, not a classification of the eventual filtration, nor an asymptotic theorem about generalized Petersen graphs.
